ownership_extension: Lead explicitly authorized the Threats.tsx optional navigation prop/header slot.
contract: URL preset=all|at-risk|missing-evidence|assigned-to-me and q edits preserve select and unrelated query parameters. Framework switches preserve filtering and use canonical workspace id, dropping cross-framework selection.

Assessment presets require an enabled non-threat framework, assessable node and inScope===true. At-risk uses derived status, missing evidence uses evidence===0, assignment uses ownerUserId for user principals only.
All/search navigates the entire graph. Counts include only matching currently in-scope assessable units; ancestor and selected context never inflate counts.

Missing/error assessment or identity data cannot claim a zero count; retry controls are explicit. Framework snapshot id and placeholder state are checked. Observatory requests 60-second refresh from the lead-owned query hook.

Filtering retains selected node and ancestors, marks Context/Outside filter, keeps roving tree focus and shortcut ownership, and provides clear/return controls plus inspector ancestor and full sibling navigation.

Phone outline reserves the standard 55-percent sheet footprint; expanded sheets hide the underlying outline while selection navigation stays in the inspector. Scroll adjustment affects only the tree scroller.
Outline status/coverage glyph legend and active scene lens labels stay visible. Only explanatory legend prose collapses. CSS colors derive from design tokens.
Optional inspector navigation preserves existing callers and the workspace/node keyed draft lifetime.
